description: This file contains functions related to staging and managing bundled plugin runtime environments, including symlink handling, overlay staging, and copying specific runtime files. It appears to be part of a build or deployment script for plugin extension management within a larger project.

methods.name: symlinkType
methods.description: Determines the symlink type based on the platform, returning 'junction' for Windows and 'dir' otherwise.

methods.name: relativeSymlinkTarget
methods.description: Calculates the relative path from the target directory to the source path.

methods.name: ensureSymlink
methods.description: Creates a symlink at the target path pointing to the target value, with handling for existing symlinks and errors.

methods.name: symlinkPath
methods.description: Creates a symlink from source to target path, ensuring correct relative path.

methods.name: shouldWrapRuntimeJsFile
methods.description: Checks if the source path points to a JavaScript (.js) file requiring wrapping.

methods.name: shouldCopyRuntimeFile
methods.description: Determines if the source file should be copied based on specific filenames (e.g., package.json, plugin.json).

methods.name: writeRuntimeModuleWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a JavaScript file with module export/import boilerplate and writes it to the target.

methods.name: stagePluginRuntimeOverlay
methods.description: Recursively overlays files and directories from a source plugin directory to a target directory, wrapping JS files and copying specific files.

methods.name: linkPluginNodeModules
methods.description: Creates a symlink for node_modules from the source plugin directory into the runtime plugin directory.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntime
methods.description: Main exported function that stages the plugin runtime environment, managing extension directories and node_modules.
